caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass pitcher with a pale green tint. The pitcher features a wide, rounded body that tapers upward into a narrower, slightly flared neck. Around the neck of the pitcher, there are several horizontal red rings encircling it. A single handle, also made of the same green-tinted glass, is attached at the top of the neck and curves downward, attaching again at the upper half of the body. Additional decorative elements include two raised, looping trails of glass that wind around the body of the pitcher, forming curls and spirals. The pitcher rests on a short, rounded pedestal base, also green-tinted. The background of the drawing is light beige with no other objects or detailing present.
title: Pitcher
